mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_execute_log (app_id, conversation_id, request, response, status, total_used_tokens, cost_time, creator, create_time) VALUES (#{appId}, #{conversationId}, COALESCE(#{request}, ''), COALESCE(#{response}, ''), #{status}, COALESCE(#{totalUsedTokens}, 0), COALESCE(#{costTime}, 0), COALESCE(#{creator}, ''), COALESCE(#{createTime}, NOW()))
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_execute_log SET response = #{response}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE agent_execute_log SET status = #{status}, response = COALESCE(#{response}, response), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_used_tokens), 0) FROM agent_execute_log WHERE app_id = #{appId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND id = #{executeId}
